ns2:section.sectionText: Early registration is restricted to students majoring in Statistics, Statistics & Computer Science or Actuarial Science. This restriction is expected to be removed sometime during the business day May 5, 2015. Some seats are reserved for incoming Statistics transfer students. If you receive a Reserved-Closed error, that means the course is full except for the reserved seats. This course is set below capacity to hold space for students transferring to Statistics from other programs of study. Capacity may fluctuate.
